units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:1">Peah II, 1</cite> <he>ש׳ הרבים</he> a public path through fields; <he>ש׳ היחיד</he> a private path, contrad. to <he>דרך</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 25:6">Ex. R. s. 25</cite> <he>ב״וד עושה לו ש׳ בדרך שמא … ש׳ בים</he> a human being makes himself a path on trodden ground, can he make himself a path in the sea?; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שְׁבִילִים</he>, <he>שְׁבִילִין</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 81a:2">B. Kam. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>ומהלכים בשְׁבִילֵי הרשות וכ׳</he> it is allowed to walk on private paths (through fields) until the second rainfall (v. <cite ref="T00101"><he>רְבִיעָה</he></cite>); <cite ref="Taanit 6b">Taan. 6ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 7:18">Tosef. Shebi. VII, 18</cite> <he>ש׳ שבשדות</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 4:3">Lev. R. s. 4</cite> <he>היו לפניו שני ש׳ וכ׳</he> if a person had before him two paths, one smooth &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>התורה הזו דומה לשני ש׳ וכ׳</he> the Torah is like two paths, the one of fire, the other of snow &c. Tanḥ. T’rumah 8 (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 5:6">Prov. V, 6</cite>) <he>שְׁבִילֶיהָ של תורה וכ׳</he> the paths of the Torah and its sections; a. e.—
Naz. 8ᵇ מנין שבילי שמיטה Var. (v. Rashi) as many as the field paths in the Sabbatical year (ed. שבלי).—בִּשְׁבִיל on account of, for the sake of; because.
<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>בש׳ אשתו ובניו</he> for his wife and children.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:4">Sabb. II, 4</cite> <he>בש׳ שתהא מנטפת</he> in order that it may drip.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>בש׳ החולה שישן</he> for the sake of a patient, that he may sleep.
<cite ref="Sukkah 29a:13">Succ. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>בש׳ ארבעה דברים</he> for four reasons.
<cite ref="Sotah 46b:13">Sot. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>בש׳ שכנעני וכ׳</he> because this Canaanite showed the way with his finger.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3">Num. R. s. 3<sup>6</sup></cite> <he>שלחה בש׳ וכ׳</he> she sent for R. J.; a. v. fr.
